card.name: The word behavioral in neurological symptom lists
card.fires_on: The word "behavioral" closing a list such as "neurological, cognitive, or behavioral" signs or symptoms, mostly in warnings about PML or PTLD. It is weaker on a few nouns after "Laboratory" or "holidays and".
